messages.text:
I can't refund the duvet set yet. The shop's return records don't show it as received back, and the shop refunds only units it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return). So I can't start a refund for it now.

If you did send it, tell me and I'll ask a staff member to check. If you haven't sent it yet, it has to reach the shop first. Your order's refund deadline is 2026-11-11 19:23 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).

Have you already sent it?
